name: Dr. Alina Okonkwo
bio: Alina has looked after families in Ashford for twelve years and leads our diabetes clinic. She is also the practice's safeguarding lead.

name: Dr. Ravi Menon
bio: Ravi joined in 2018 and runs the respiratory clinic. He is interested in helping patients manage asthma and COPD at home.

name: Dr. Elena Rossi
bio: Elena has a special interest in women's health and minor surgery. She also supervises our GP trainees.

name: Sister Grace Abbott
bio: Grace leads the vaccination programme, including the winter flu clinic. She has been a practice nurse for over twenty years.

name: Nurse Daniel Okafor
bio: Daniel runs our travel health and wound-care clinics. He is happy to talk through vaccination options before you book.

name: Amara Boateng
bio: Amara advises on repeat prescriptions and medication reviews. The pharmacy counter is on the ground floor beside reception.

name: Dr. Priya Shah
bio: Priya treats joint, muscle and back pain and runs a weekly exercise group. She works with patients to build a plan they can keep up at home.

name: Jonah Field
bio: Jonah offers short-term counselling and runs the Thursday drop-in. No referral is needed to start a conversation.

name: Tomas Lindqvist
bio: Tomas leads the reception team and can help with appointments, letters and access requests. The front desk is open during all clinic hours.

name: Mariam Haddad
bio: Mariam looks after the day-to-day running of the practice, including staffing, estates and patient feedback.
